name: Focus
title: usefocus.co
payoff: Align teams and manage goals efficiently
shortDescription: Focus is a streamlined application designed for remote team management, focusing on goal setting, OKRs, and task management. It simplifies daily and weekly check-ins, reducing the need for excessive meetings and spreadsheets. Ideal for managers looking to enhance team productivity and engagement through structured objectives and key results. An example use case is a distributed team using Focus to set quarterly OKRs and track progress through automated updates.
cons: May not suit non-remote teams as well
Dependent on third-party integrations for full functionality
